$comment: Which game data the importer may use. Rules for this file are in README.md next to it. A source that is not listed here is excluded.

sources.name: Dungeons & Dragons System Reference Document 5.2.1
sources.evidence: Publisher web page. The PDF's own license notice has not been read
conditions: Copy the attribution statement from the PDF before the first import
SRD text only, not other books
The license does not grant trademark use

sources.name: Dungeon World
sources.license: CC-BY-3.0, with some D&D SRD 5.1 material under CC-BY-4.0
sources.evidence: Repository license file. The full Creative Commons legal code was not read
conditions: Credit both the CC-BY-3.0 text and the SRD 5.1 material

sources.name: Blades in the Dark System Reference Document
conditions: SRD text only: no setting, art or maps
Do not use the game's name in a product title
Use the attribution text from the licensing page

sources.name: Fate System Reference Document
conditions: Use the Creative Commons route and its credit text
Fate and Powered by Fate are trademarks; the logo has its own terms

sources.name: OpenQuest Systems Resource Document
conditions: SRD text only, not the main rulebook
Do not use the OpenQuest name or logo in our work

sources.name: Basic Roleplaying: Universal Game Engine
sources.evidence: Publisher page, and the linked license PDF, which is labeled interim
sources.reason: Confirm the final license text. Adapted rules material must be offered under ORC; settings, names and art are reserved

sources.name: Cepheus Engine System Reference Document
sources.license: Open Game License, version not confirmed
